messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated tail latency and error spike for model-infer pool-gpu-3 in us-east-2. P95 -> P99 widened, error rate ~8% across several endpoints. Paging oncall SRE: @oncall-sre

maria: i'm on it. quick glance at host metrics shows GPU SM stalls and memory pressure on g3-2..g3-4. seeing OOM kills in the model-server logs.

raj: i can reproduce seq_len spikes when requests > 2k tokens. lots of kv cache churn reported. any rolling deploys?

maria: no deploys in last hour. infra telemetry: GPU util 95-99%, unusual memory growth over ~45m. top processes: model-server (pids 2321/2345).

ops-bot: Suggestion from auto-runbook: offload traffic from pool-gpu-3 -> pool-gpu-fallback-1 (gradual). Command queued: 
```
infra route set --from pool-gpu-3 --to pool-gpu-fallback-1 --weight 0.6 --grace 120
```

lee: can we protect paid customers first? propose partial brownout for free/guest tiers + rate limit unauth routes. keep enterprise traffic pinned to fallback provider.

maria: agreed. i'll enact quota update and toggle the free-tier feature flag for us-east-2. support please prep customer comms.

support-bot: Draft for status page / outbound: 
```
We're implementing temporary shaping for free-tier requests in us-east-2 due to elevated latency. Paid customers should see no disruption. Engineers are mitigating; expected restoration ~30m.
```

raj: applying soft qps caps on unauth endpoints now:
```
api rate-limit update --scope unauth --region us-east-2 --qps 20 --mode soft
```

maria: starting graceful drain of two noisy hosts in pool-gpu-3: 
```
infra drain host g3-2 --grace 300 --allow-inflight
infra drain host g3-3 --grace 300 --allow-inflight
```

incident-bot: Oncall handoff scheduled in 15m: @maria -> @lee (handoff required because maria needs to rotate).

lee: i'm taking over monitoring. initiating provider-level reroute for high-throughput customer segments to our alternate provider (pool-gpu-fallback-1). implementing traffic-class routing: 
```
router policy create --name high-tp-reroute --match "tier:enterprise AND qps>50" --dest pool-gpu-fallback-1 --priority 900
```

maria: after shifting ~60% of traffic off pool-gpu-3 p99 dropped ~40%, errors down to ~2.1%. good signal.

support: we already received a ticket from Acme Corp (INC-4021) reporting intermittent timeouts at ~12:40. notified them of mitigation.

raj: metrics look stable for 10m. recommending keep brownout active for 30m total and then progressive restore (undrain + lift qps caps). tagging for postmortem.

lee: agree. schedule: continue monitoring, undrain g3-2/g3-3 at 25m mark if stable, then remove rate-limits in rolling manner. i'll take responsibility for rollback steps.

maria: inserting logs snippet for root cause clues: 
```
2026-03-12T12:38:02Z host=g3-2 kernel: oom-killer invoked
2026-03-12T12:38:05Z model-server[2345]: ERROR out-of-memory while allocating KV cache
2026-03-12T12:38:06Z model-server[2345]: worker 17 killed, restarting
```

maria: preliminary hypothesis: noisy co-tenant on g3 family causing leak/pressure + long-context requests causing KV cache thrash. short-term mitigation = host evacuation + tiered brownout + shaping. long-term actions: per-tenant memory caps, seq_len-based routing, blacklist noisy tenant.

oncall-sre: creating incident ticket INC-2026-112 with action items and assigning to infra/serving.

support: customer outreach done: Acme, BetaStart, GammaApps notified via DM and status. no escalations beyond single ticket.

ops-bot: runbook note appended: "if GPU memory leak suspected -> isolate host family; begin staged evacuations; consider provider fallback before full drain."

maria: closing update: mitigations in place, monitoring in watch state. will handoff final monitoring to @lee. pls attach logs & metrics to INC-2026-112.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. last recorded mitigation action: 1768006123 :white_check_mark:
